capabilities.text: Draw: drag from an atom to add a carbon or from empty space to start a chain, drag onto an atom to bond, tap a bond for double then triple
capabilities.note: Not doing: "Their freehand structure-drawing surface in `structure-editor` unless it is chosen as a round; the `organic-structure` generator is the in-scope part."

capabilities.text: Move: drag a bond to move its structure, an atom to move it alone (snapping), or a box to move several atoms
capabilities.note: Not doing: "Their freehand structure-drawing surface in `structure-editor` unless it is chosen as a round; the `organic-structure` generator is the in-scope part."

capabilities.text: Delete: tap an atom or bond, or drag a box
capabilities.note: Not doing: "Their freehand structure-drawing surface in `structure-editor` unless it is chosen as a round; the `organic-structure` generator is the in-scope part."

capabilities.text: Select with shift-click, delete the selection, undo with Ctrl+Z
capabilities.note: Not doing: "Their freehand structure-drawing surface in `structure-editor` unless it is chosen as a round; the `organic-structure` generator is the in-scope part."

capabilities.text: Place atoms other than carbon (H, O and more) and ring templates (cyclopentane, cyclohexane, benzene) into the drawing
capabilities.note: Not doing: "Their freehand structure-drawing surface in `structure-editor` unless it is chosen as a round; the `organic-structure` generator is the in-scope part." These are the editor's palette; ours has ring skeletons only as whole-figure presets. Raised as a scope question.
From the page's Figure controls, which act on the whole drawing; skeletal is the opening state. Narrow form: ours prints one condensed formula line; the wide form is cap-06a2.

capabilities.text: Condensed view written on the drawing: H3C, CH2, CH3 at each carbon's place in the structure
capabilities.note: Built in batch 6, round 286 (2026-11-10). Wide form of cap-06a (narrow/wide convention). Ours has no per-atom condensed labels.

capabilities.text: Full structural formula display (every H drawn)
'Carbons' display: the skeletal zigzag with a C written at every carbon atom and no hydrogens
capabilities.note: Built in batch 6, round 287 (2026-11-10). Checked live 2026-11-08 on a drawn butane: Carbons keeps the skeletal bonds and writes C at all four vertices, no H (Condensed writes H3C/CH2, Full draws every H). Ours has Skeletal, Condensed and Full only (MODES in organic.rs), so no evidence.
On at the opening state; the token turns it off.
